title: Crash with RichtTextLabel under specific circumstances
body:
### Tested versions

4.5.1 stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Fedora Linux 43 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 840M Graphics (radeonsi, gfx1152, LLVM 21.1.4, DRM 3.64, 6.17.7-300.fc43.x86_64) - AMD Ryzen AI 5 340 w/ Radeon 840M (12 threads) - 14.28 GiB memory

`Object was deleted while awaiting a callback.` continues for a while.

### Steps to reproduce

I need help finding the exact cause, not only because I cannot further edit down the main scene, as the engine keeps crashing instantly. Please don't hesitate to ask more question, as I understand that the information given is very vague. 

I have also found, while putting together the MRP, that deleting the .godot folder will cause the issue to go away. However, reloading the project will cause a crash again.

This is the main scene structure:

ControlNode
> MarginContainer
>>GridContainer
>>>MarginContainer
>>>>TextureRect
>>>>RichTextLabel (text = "[b] 123" with bbc code enabled)

I also have a simple Theme (removing it will cause no further crashes):
```
GridContainer/constants/h_separation = 6
GridContainer/constants/v_separation = 6
RichTextLabel/constants/outline_size = 11
RichTextLabel/font_sizes/bold_font_size = 50
``` 

Then opening that scene will cause an almost instant crash.
